title: Count the street trees
brief: Our volunteer tree census still lives on clipboards, so nobody can see which blocks are done or what species dominate.

target_population.role: municipal parks volunteer logging street trees block by block
target_population.coverage_limit: six named blocks in one fictional district; no maps, coordinates, or real inventories

core_task.summary: log a tree observation and watch the block summary update
core_task.success_oracle: logging a linden with trunk diameter 32 on block B3 raises that block's count to 15 and adds linden to its species mix

not_applicable_states.loading: observations append to seeded local records and summaries recompute in memory, so entry and summary never show an in-flight state

state_recipes.empty: open block B7, which starts with zero logged trees; a start-surveying prompt replaces the summary
state_recipes.validation-error: enter a trunk diameter outside 1-300 cm; an inline range error blocks the observation
state_recipes.success: log a linden at 32 cm on block B3; the block count reads 15 with linden chipped into the mix
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the species picker shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load the entry form at 390x844; the block summary grid drops below the form

acceptance_facts: The seed contains 41 trees across six named blocks and block B3 starts with 14 logged trees.
Logging a linden on block B3 raises its count to 15 and the district total to 42.
Block B7 starts empty and shows a start-surveying prompt instead of a blank summary.

product_signature.mechanism: block-progress grid that fills as observations land
product_signature.anchor: block summary grid beside the entry form
product_signature.brief_trace: nobody can see which blocks are done or what species dominate
product_signature.counterfactual: a flat table of trees would fit a spreadsheet brief and never shows survey completeness per block
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows B3 at 15 trees with the linden chip added to its mix

anti_goals: no map tiles, geolocation, or coordinates; blocks are named units
no photo upload or species-identification claims; species come from a fixed picker
no public dashboard or resident-facing reporting

content_seed.data_notes: 41 invented trees across six blocks; B7 is deliberately empty to fix the empty state and the district total lands at 42 after the core task
